summary: Comprehensive frontend-only smoke test of TRIAS Skin & NTD PWA prototype. Login (valid+invalid), MIS dashboard (8 KPI cards, 4 charts, 3 alert panels), cascading filters (Madang -> 4 records, 2 districts, Clear -> 6 records), role-based access (admin sees 6 patients, joseph sees 4, mary sees 1), View-only panel + disabled 'New scabies encounter' for Mary, /admin Restricted panel for non-admin, quick registration (name/age/sex/weight save; weight<15 shows ivermectin contraindicated alert; Female -> pregnancy row; pregnancy=Yes -> alert), scabies 9-step wizard (all steps render, suspect flag transitions Not suspected -> Suspected scabies -> Suspected crusted scabies with red URGENT alert, body chart Front/Back+16 regions+lesion dialog save works, Step 6 ivermectin calc for Elijah 21kg = 4200 µg / 4.2 mg, Lucy 12kg shows block alert, Complete encounter returns to record), Sync page clears queue (4 queued -> Synced), PWA manifest.json (200, standalone, all keys) and sw.js (200). Mobile 390x844 and tablet 820x1180 have zero horizontal overflow; bottom nav bar shows MIS/Patients/New/Sync/Admin. No console errors observed.
action_items: Minor: data-testid naming inconsistency between review-request spec and code — code uses 'worse-night-yes' (not 'worse-at-night-yes') and 'add-user-btn' (not 'create-user-btn'). Consider aligning naming for automation clarity; functionality is not affected.
critical_code_review_comments: store.js: pendingSync counter is decoupled from the actual queue (encounters with synced=false + patients created). syncNow sets pendingSync=0 and marks encounters synced but never marks patients as synced. Acceptable for prototype but should be unified in real build.
ScabiesEncounter.jsx likely large (9-step wizard) — recommend splitting each step into its own component when the wizard grows beyond ~700 lines to keep it maintainable.
Access control filter in visiblePatients() uses simple facility/createdBy match — good for prototype; needs server-side enforcement in real backend.
Data persistence relies solely on localStorage under 'trias.state.v1' — acceptable for prototype but no IndexedDB is actually used yet despite the offline-first claim; consider Dexie for real build.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded mock data; cleared localStorage between role switches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a NO-BACKEND clickable prototype. All state in localStorage key 'trias.state.v1'. Testid conventions actually in code: filter-<name> for dashboard filters (NOT bare province/district), worse-night-yes (NOT worse-at-night-yes), add-user-btn on Admin (NOT create-user-btn). Wizard step tabs step-tab-1..9, wizard-next/prev/finish-btn, suspect-flag, body-view-front/back, body-region-<id>, lesion-dialog, lesion-save, lesion-severity-<level>. Sync: sync-status-chip and sync-now-btn. Use Admin -> reset-demo-btn or clear localStorage between role switches.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 18 features listed in the review request behaved as specified.
